fields.finding: Headline targets allocate the entire risk budget to tube fracture and use an independent series model. Joints, membrane, instability, shared batches and common-cause events are omitted.
fields.needed: A whole-frame failure definition and allocated risk budget; valid component marginals and dependence/common-cause model.
fields.effect: The conditional series probabilities are not whole-vehicle reliability claims. Union-bound allocations avoid independence but do not supply missing marginal probabilities.

claim: Headline targets allocate the entire risk budget to tube fracture and use an independent series model. Joints, membrane, instability, shared batches and common-cause events are omitted.
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: The common equations do not qualify the bond, core law, coatings or installed safety factor. Carry the exact conventions, not an interchangeable headline. [052 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:3a70e117fbb14e85), [CHECK053](unpublished-local-ref:599d3a276c2fcbce).
